visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A blonde woman faces the camera in a bright indoor room, framing her face with her hands and smiling. White text overlays appear. (2) She points her fingers upwards excitedly as the text changes to announce an upcoming festival. The background is a clean, neutral-toned room. (3) Seated on a beige sofa, she holds a white headset in her right hand and a black one in her left, gesturing toward them. (4) A split-screen shot shows her wearing the white headset outdoors while walking, and then indoors in a gaming chair with vibrant purple lighting. (5) A screen recording shows a mobile app interface with the brand logo. (6) A close-up demonstrates the white headset's earcups being squeezed, highlighting their texture. Behind her is a computer monitor. (7) She wears a black headset and a brown top, posing confidently against a solid gray wall, her hands touching the earcups. (8) The video cuts to her gameplay, showing a first-person shooter screen while she talks into the headset's boom microphone. (9) She holds both headsets close to her face, smiling and making a finger-heart gesture. Promotion details and pricing appear as text overlays.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo electronic BGM with a strong percussive beat starts immediately. A high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice begins speaking with fast delivery and bright intonation. (2) A digital 'whoosh' transition SFX marks a visual shift. The vocal pitch remains high as she lists dates, with clear articulation and minimal pauses. (3) BGM continues at a steady volume. A 'ding' sound effect emphasizes the mention of 'tri-mode connection'. The voice is projected and energetic. (4) A subtle 'pop' sound effect coincides with a text change. The speaker's tone shifts slightly more toward professional narration while maintaining a friendly vibe. (5) A louder transition 'impact' sound occurs when a new headset model is named. The music maintains its driving rhythm under the clear vocal track. (6) The vocal delivery slows slightly for the pricing information, then speeds up for the final call to action. BGM fades out with a final beat.
